initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in upstream provenance assembly. Job 1 preserved the needs records, but its evidence_sources handoff assigns provenance ranks in the wrong order: the lowest-demand record n06-r08 is rank 1 while the highest-demand record n06-r01 is rank 8. This violates the requirement to preserve deterministic source provenance in demand-descending rank order. Job 2 then used those supplied upstream ranks consistently, so the downstream recommendation follows the faulty upstream handoff rather than being the root fault.
